foundation_fragments.description: Общая детерминированная основа для анализа Java-систем: состав репозитория, конфигурация, зависимости, интерфейсы, структурная модель, универсальные Tree-sitter observations, SQL, физическая схема и технические взаимодействия.
foundation_fragments.name: Reusable Java repository analysis foundation

global_architecture_diagnostics.finding: Java profile stages are runtime-controlled, but dependency order and data passing are encoded in pipeline.py rather than stage contracts.
Spec profile pipeline.stages are descriptive labels; run_spec_analysis executes a fixed normalization pipeline and only reads profile metadata.
Several Java stages consume the whole accumulated AnalysisResult, preventing independent caching and making results depend on profile execution history.

Conceptual-model assembly still combines already extracted facts and remains a candidate for final KLC ownership; system description and reference data now publish typed Core evidence and materialize in KLC.
The catalog can now show observed Java requires/provides and mutation behavior, but Core profiles still do not declare or validate those contracts.
db_schema_scan extracts physical declarations and also launches SQL table observations, mixing base and derived evidence in one stage.

known_boundaries.foundation_current_role: reusable repository analysis artifact built by Core and lifecycle-managed by external orchestration

categories.base_evidence: Direct repository/spec declarations and source observations.
categories.derived_evidence: Deterministic facts derived from source observations with provenance and no business verdict.
categories.knowledge_materialization_candidate: Cross-fact task/model views that should be evaluated for relocation to Knowledge Layer.
categories.technical_packaging: Normalization, compatibility, coverage and output serialization.

classification_policy.primary_boundary: Core extracts direct and derived evidence; KLC assembles cross-fact knowledge; packaging serializes outputs.
classification_policy.uncertainty_policy: A stage remains in Core when it produces evidence with provenance; only cross-fact model/view assembly is marked as a KLC candidate.

architecture_findings.finding: The observed requires/provides relations are encoded in pipeline.py and scanner signatures; profiles do not declare them.
java_data_model_lineage_build changes output composition and can rebuild persistence internally depending on whether persistence ran earlier.
java_table_observation_build accepts all accumulated facts but currently filters only jpa_entity and jpa_relationship facts.
